newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Rizal Bank to forge real estate jv.
newsitem.headline: Rizal Bank to forge real estate jv.

text.p: Rizal Commercial Banking Corp (RCBC) will enter into a memorandum of understanding for a joint venture with the Government of Singapore Investment Corp (GIC) and another local firm to put up a building in Manila's financial district of Makati City.

In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange on Thursday, the bank said it plans to have a 45 percent stake in the development and construction of the RCBC Plaza on a 10,451 square metre lot owned by RCBC and PMMIC Realty Corp (PRC).
RCBC added that its executive committee had authorised the execution of the MOU.
The Singaporean firm is proposing a 15 percent stake while PRC is eyeing a 15 percent participation in the venture.
